spans.text: We examined sex differences in regional brain responses during identification of negative emotional face versus neutral shape stimuli.

description.value: Standard fMRI preprocessing in SPM8, including realignment, mean-image construction, co-registration to structural MPRAGE, segmentation, affine and nonlinear normalization, and Gaussian smoothing.

spans.text: Standard image preprocessing was performed. Images of each individual subject were first realigned (motion corrected). A mean functional image volume was constructed for each subject per run from the realigned image volumes. These mean images were co-registered with the high-resolution structural MPRAGE image and then segmented for normalization with affine registration followed by nonlinear transformation. The normalization parameters determined for the structural volume were then applied to the corresponding functional image volumes for each subject. Finally, the images were smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 4 mm at Full Width at Half Maximum.

description.value: Participants identified negative facial emotion targets and neutral shape targets in alternating blocks.

spans.text: Each participant completed two runs of an emotion processing task each with 6 blocks – 3 of negative face and 3 of neutral shape pictures – in a fixed order: neutral – negative – neutral – negative – neutral – negative.
